referencePolicy: Use the reference for clarity and contract quality only; preserve this skill folder name, tool behavior, language, framework style, and output paths.
rules: Use only explicitly selected and approved input from the user or backend request.
Do not invoke or modify TestCaseGeneration-Skills from automation-script skills.
Do not output local absolute paths such as D:\skills or D:\frameworks as generated client paths.
Generated output must stay inside the selected client framework root.
Keep runtime secrets and environment values outside generated source code.
Healing may patch generated client files only and should require rerun evidence before push.

Every selected runnable test case requires four generated files: features/<Feature>.feature, stepDefinitions/<Feature>Steps.java, pages/<Feature>Page.java, and pageObjects/<Feature>PageObjects.java, plus test-data files when runtime data is needed.
Generated feature scenarios carry the test case ID tag and a runnable runner tag (@smoke/@regression); never tag generated files @template.
confidenceTarget: 90-95 after sample generation and run automation validation against mapped static framework.
